# Anchors & titles

Headings that Glaux and GitHub-style slugs treat differently. See [punctuation](#don-t-panic), [underscores](#snake-case-name), [accents](#año-nuevo), [a repeated heading](glaux://guide/anchors#same), [the title](#anchors-titles) and [a number](#same-2).

## Don't panic

Text.

## snake_case_name

Text.

## Año nuevo

Text.

## Same

First.

## Same

Second, which Glaux cannot link to.

## Same 2

A heading whose anchor is the one a repeat would get.

## Anchors & titles

Repeats the page title, which keeps the anchor.

## !!!

No letters or digits.

> ### Quoted heading
>
> Glaux does not read headings inside a quote.
